title: The search API takes the shape drafted on the search-api branch
body:
The search surface on `refactor` at c6c9b53 is `SuffixArray::open` (everything in memory), `open_with(filename, text: Storage, suffixes: Storage, max_query_len)`, `search` and `search_all` returning `Hits`, per-element `suffix_at`, `lcp_at` and `string_at`, a whole-array `suffixes()` iterator, and `Hits::extract(before, after)` returning `Extraction` records that carry their bytes.

The `search-api` branch, never merged, drafted the same shape with different choices. This takes those over.

## Proposal

- `open` opens on disk; `open_with(filename, &OpenOptions { text, suffixes, max_query_len })` with a `Default`.
- `suffixes(Range)`, `lcps(Range)` and `text(Range)` replace `suffix_at`, `lcp_at`, `suffixes()` and `string_at`.
- `Hits::extract(Context { before: usize, after: Option<usize> })`; `Hits::is_empty`.
- `Location` gains `sequence_start`; `Extraction` holds a `Location`, its `sequence_range` and `suffix_offset`, and no bytes.
- `search` returns `Result<Hits>` and `search_all` returns `Vec<Result<Hits>>`, with disk read errors carried out of the binary search. That part is sufr-09e733.
- The branch's example at `libsufr/examples/search.rs`, and its `Cow` borrow of in-memory text in the compare, the latter benchmarked on its own.

The CLI's output stays the same; the differential sweep is the check.
close_reason: Landed on refactor as 583f39d (OpenOptions), 340da3a (range reads), a4dc338 (Context and a byte-free Extraction), 9049092 (fallible search) and 6edc011 (the example). The Cow borrow was already there as text_slice. The sweep of 7,376 runs against c6c9b53 is identical in stdout, exit codes and .sufr bytes.
